consent.title: Before you take part
paragraphs: This study looks at how AI can support people learning in small groups.
If you take part, we will record what you do in this platform, including your test and questionnaire answers, group messages, edits, and use of AI support.
When AI help is requested, the task, relevant group chat, and shared answer may be sent to the AI provider. Names are replaced with labels such as "Member A" where possible.
Private AI help stays private unless you choose to share it. Group facilitator suggestions are visible to your group.
Your group can see your nickname, but your research data uses an anonymous code.
Taking part is your choice. You can stop or withdraw at any time.

checkboxes.text: I have read and understood the study information.
I understand that relevant group content may be sent to an AI provider when help is requested.
I agree to take part and know I can stop at any time.

consent.contact: If you have questions, please contact the study researcher.
consent.withdrawal: To withdraw, select "Withdraw my consent" in the lobby. We will stop collecting new data from you.

conditionDisclosure.baseline_private_request: In this session you can ask the AI privately for support in Step 2.
conditionDisclosure.shared_on_demand: In this session you can ask the AI privately for support in Step 2. In the Step 1 group chat, anyone can ask the AI Collaboration Assistant for collaboration help; its reply appears in the chat for everyone.
conditionDisclosure.proactive_group: In this session you can ask the AI privately for support in Step 2. In the Step 1 group chat, anyone can ask the AI Collaboration Assistant for collaboration help, and it may now and then offer your group a collaboration question. Its replies appear in the chat for everyone. You decide whether to open or hide these offers.
conditionDisclosure.dual_adaptive: In this session you can ask the AI privately for support in Step 2. In the Step 1 group chat, anyone can ask the AI Collaboration Assistant for collaboration help, and it may now and then offer your group a collaboration question. Its replies appear in the chat for everyone. The separate private AI coach has been removed.
conditionDisclosure.proactive_adaptive: In this session you can ask the AI privately for support in Step 2. In the Step 1 group chat, anyone can ask the AI Collaboration Assistant for collaboration help, and it may now and then offer your group a collaboration question. Its replies appear in the chat for everyone. In addition, a small private pop-up may sometimes ask whether you would like a hint or a guiding question. Only you see it, nothing is sent to the AI unless you click Yes, and it adapts to how you respond: if you choose No thanks, you will be offered fewer. It never gives the answer.
